cues.text: Kujo Payments is a portable payment layer for agents.
Request a merchant and spending limit, without giving the agent payment credentials.
Bind approval to the action before execution.
Then inspect the result and receipt. This demo is simulated; no real money moves.
Next: validate the Link adapter in a sandbox, and gather developer feedback.
